description: neuro-os MCP server — exposes the Three-Layer Research OS + founder-loop + cross-vertical tool surface to MCP-compatible AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, mcp-cli, anything that speaks MCP stdio). The 9 tools mirror the high-leverage `neuro-os ...` CLI subcommands. All persistence flows through the same on-disk queues the CLI uses, so MCP-driven writes are visible to subsequent CLI runs and vice versa.
